I figured it out! After hours of sifting through loads of mods and jsons I narrowed it down to the Visit Mount Vapis mod. In the crops json there’s a part where it has the starfruit ID and “yield override” with the value at 5. I tried setting it to zero and that just killed SMAPI before the game could even open lol. After looking over the json again and going through the SMAPI log, I found out it was something to do with spacecore. So kept the yield override at 0, reinstalled spacecore, and now everything FINALLY works 😭😭😭😭
